lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible; the medial row exhibits 6-8 distinct local maxima posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal rows to form a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and a shadow vector below.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of small, high-luminance blobs is visible on the anterior cephalic region and the leading edge of the left pectoral fin.
